post.summary: Record a bounded, idempotent own reading signal
post.description: Approximate client telemetry; not proof of reading. Repeated events within one day do not repeatedly increment the interest revision. Only completed reading is a positive seed. Also records a durable unique view for a successful open/read of an approved story. One reader contributes one view per story for its lifetime; author self-views are excluded. This accounting works when semantic recommendations are disabled and survives recommendation-signal cleanup. No view is recorded by GET requests or feed previews.

get.description: Requires a verified user token. The existing /api/v1/profile stays private and editable only by its owner. Unfilled authors with published stories get the fallback nickname and null description/avatar; unknown or private-only authors without a profile return 404. Public presence also includes accounts with incoming/outgoing subscription edges; this makes verified subscribers without filled profile details visible with the fallback nickname. following is viewer-specific and the response must not be shared-cached.

put.description: Idempotent desired-state operation. Actor comes only from the verified JWT; no request body or actor ID is accepted as authority. Self-subscription is rejected with 400. PUT requires an existing public author; DELETE also succeeds when the edge is already absent. The response describes the target account and this viewer’s edge. Concurrent requests for the same edge serialize in PostgreSQL.

get.description: Current outgoing subscription edges only; no caller-supplied account ID. Includes previously published stories as well as future publications, newest first using (created_at,id). No own posts, pending new stories or unapproved edits. Unfollowing removes an author on subsequent reads. Cursor pagination is live, not a frozen snapshot: refresh to include newer posts/new subscriptions.

parameters.name: cursor
parameters.description: Opaque nextCursor from the same account and list direction

parameters.name: q
parameters.description: Optional case-insensitive literal substring of the public nickname. Surrounding whitespace is trimmed. Searches the entire selected connection list before pagination; %, _ and + are literal characters.

400.description: Invalid UUID, limit, search term or cursor from another profile/list/search

get.description: Verified users with api.read can read public connection lists. Rows expose only nickname, avatar hash, account ID and the requesting viewer’s following state. Newest relationships first, using (created_at, member account ID), with opaque cursor bound to this profile and list direction. Reading one’s own empty list succeeds even without filled profile details. Pagination reads live edges; refresh for new relationships above the current cursor. Search is applied in PostgreSQL before LIMIT. Cursors are bound to the normalized search term as well as the profile/list direction; change q only when starting a fresh page. Legacy cursors remain accepted for an empty search.
